name: Sarajevo ili Smrt
description: DJ bez reputacije osvaja Sarajevo noć po noć — slider mehanika, 3 kvarta, prestige reset, Avala Headliner terminal goal.

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap, wire sve module, game loop
modules.src/config.js: BASE_LP, prestige multipliers, wave params, KVART audio configs
modules.src/state.js: Game state shape, save/load localStorage, offline timestamp
modules.src/input.js: Touch drag + mouse drag za slider, keyboard fallback
modules.src/render.js: Canvas: Sarajevo mapa, vibe wave, crowd bar, particles, fog-of-war
modules.src/ui.js: HUD (LP counter, crowd bar, timer), upgrade shop, season planner ekran
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio — per-kvart ambient, SFX (LP gain, unlock, prestige, legend)
modules.src/share.js: Offscreen Canvas share kartica render + Web Share API
modules.src/systems/idle.js: Idle LP/h kalkulator, offline progress catch-up
modules.src/systems/session.js: Slider fizika, vibe wave oscillation, scoring formula
modules.src/systems/progression.js: LP tracking, achievement gate checks, season end obračun
modules.src/systems/prestige.js: Prestige reset, DK kalkulacija, permanent bonus apply
modules.src/systems/upgrades.js: Upgrade shop: cost formulas (expo), effect application, prereq check
modules.src/systems/reputation.js: Mahala rep per kvart, bad rep events, kicked out logic, decay
modules.src/systems/season.js: Sezona planning UI, noć scheduling, resource carry-over
modules.src/systems/daily_challenge.js: LCG seed po datumu, daily score, localStorage LB
modules.src/systems/kvartovi/bascarsija.js: Wave speed modifier (B<2→1.5×), sevdah bonus logic
modules.src/systems/kvartovi/grbavica.js: Underground: instant fail 20% chance (reduced by E), legend bonus×1.50
modules.src/entities/crowd.js: Crowd entity: tier/color calc, reaction picker, bar data
modules.src/entities/dj.js: DJ entity: title by prestige/D, share data builder, status
modules.src/entities/klub.js: Klub entity: tier, capacity, booking_fee calc per kvart
modules.src/content/aforizmi.js: Per-kvart crowd reactions, unlock texts, prestige flavor
modules.src/content/brand_hooks.js: Avala CTA string-ovi, Kluboslavija overlay data, share copy
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD dizajn, upgrade shop cards, season planner grid
modules.styles/game.css: Vibe wave animacije, crowd bar transition, screen shake, particle CSS
